title: A homological generalized Property R conjecture is false
summary: The generalized Property R conjecture (GPRC) predicts that if framed surgery on an $n$-component link $L$ in $S^3$ produces $\#^{n} (S^1\times S^2)$, then $L$ is handleslide equivalent to an unlink, the obvious way to construct such a surgery. Many potential counterexamples to the GPRC are known, but obstructing handleslide equivalence is a tricky proposition. In this vein, we disprove a further generalization of the GPRC.
